claims.quote: Oshirasama (Japanese: おしら様, おしらさま, お白様, オシラ様, or オシラサマ, Hepburn: oshira-sama) is a tutelary deity of the home in Japanese folklore.

statement.id: Oshira-sama adalah dewa pelindung rumah dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.
statement.en: Oshira-sama is a household protective deity in Japanese folklore.

claims.quote: It is believed that when Oshirasama is in a person's home, one cannot eat meat and only women are allowed to touch it.

statement.id: Sebagian kebiasaan rumah membatasi daging dan siapa yang boleh menyentuh wujud sucinya.
statement.en: Some household customs restrict meat and who may touch its sacred image.

claims.quote: Born from a stallion and human woman, "images of this god [Oshira] are usually composed of the faces of a horse and a maiden." The festival day for Oshirasama is called meinichi (命日, or a death anniversary).

statement.id: Gambarnya memadukan wajah kuda dan perempuan muda.
statement.en: Its images combine the faces of a horse and a maiden.

claims.quote: According to myth, Oshira-sama was born from a stallion and a maiden falling in love.

statement.id: Satu mitos menghubungkan dewa itu dengan cinta antara perempuan dan kuda jantan.
statement.en: One myth connects the deity with love between a woman and a stallion.

claims.quote: Angered by the affair, the maiden's father killed the stallion and stripped it of its skin. "The skin then wrapped itself around the daughter and took her up to heaven. Later, they descended from heaven, incarnated as silkworms. After this they became the guardian gods of families and were called Jūrokuzen no kami."

statement.id: Dalam mitos, ayah sang gadis yang murka membunuh kuda jantan dan menguliti kulitnya; kulit itu membungkus sang putri dan membawanya ke langit. Keduanya kemudian turun sebagai ulat sutra, lalu menjadi dewa penjaga keluarga yang disebut Jūrokuzen no kami.
statement.en: In the myth, the maiden's angry father killed the stallion and stripped its skin; the skin wrapped around the daughter and took her to heaven. Later they descended as silkworms and became guardian gods of families called Jūrokuzen no kami.

claims.quote: The original story can be read in Sōushén Jì, a Chinese classic written in the fourth century

statement.id: Kisah asli mitos ini dapat dibaca dalam Sōushén Jì, karya klasik Tiongkok yang ditulis pada abad keempat.
statement.en: The original story can be read in Sōushén Jì, a Chinese classic written in the fourth century.

claims.quote: Having emerged from great hardship, the Oshira god is often invoked by Itakos or shamans to provide healing to individuals facing similar turmoil in their personal lives.

statement.id: Karena lahir dari kesulitan besar, dewa Oshira sering dipanggil oleh itako atau dukun untuk menyembuhkan orang yang menghadapi gejolak serupa dalam hidup pribadinya.
statement.en: Having emerged from great hardship, the Oshira god is often invoked by itako or shamans to provide healing to individuals facing similar turmoil in their personal lives.

claims.quote: The deity is also a character for the film Spirited Away. In the American version of the film the character is called Radish Spirit.

statement.id: Dewa ini juga menjadi tokoh dalam film Spirited Away; dalam versi Amerika film itu tokoh tersebut disebut Radish Spirit.
statement.en: The deity is also a character in the film Spirited Away; in the American version of the film the character is called Radish Spirit.

claims.quote: A tutelary of the home (ie no kami) found throughout Japan's northeastern region; also referred to as Oshirabotoke ("the Oshira Buddha").

statement.id: Oshirasama adalah dewa pelindung rumah (ie no kami) yang ditemukan di seluruh wilayah timur laut Jepang, juga disebut Oshirabotoke ("Buddha Oshira").
statement.en: Oshirasama is a tutelary of the home (ie no kami) found throughout Japan's northeastern region, also called Oshirabotoke ("the Oshira Buddha").

claims.quote: Although Oshirasama is commonly viewed as a tutelary of agriculture and silkworm production, little agreement has been reached regarding the etymology of the name Oshira and the kami's specific characteristics.

statement.id: Oshirasama umumnya dipandang sebagai dewa pelindung pertanian dan produksi ulat sutra, tetapi belum ada kesepakatan tentang asal nama Oshira dan ciri khusus kami ini.
statement.en: Oshirasama is commonly viewed as a tutelary of agriculture and silkworm production, but little agreement has been reached on the etymology of the name Oshira and the kami's specific characteristics.

claims.quote: The object of Oshirasama worship generally consists of a pair of sticks of mulberry (ocassionally bamboo) about 30 cm long, with male and female faces (or a horse's head) carved or painted in ink on one end.

statement.id: Benda pemujaan Oshirasama umumnya berupa sepasang tongkat murbei (kadang bambu) sepanjang sekitar 30 cm dengan wajah laki-laki dan perempuan (atau kepala kuda) yang diukir atau dilukis dengan tinta di salah satu ujungnya.
statement.en: The object of Oshirasama worship generally consists of a pair of mulberry sticks (occasionally bamboo) about 30 cm long, with male and female faces (or a horse's head) carved or painted in ink on one end.

claims.quote: The images are clothed in layers of cloth called osendaku which are added to each year.

statement.id: Gambar-gambar itu dikenakan lapisan kain bernama osendaku yang ditambah setiap tahun.
statement.en: The images are clothed in layers of cloth called osendaku, which are added to each year.

claims.quote: Devotees of Oshirasama may be composed of individual homes, lineage groups (dōzokudan), geographically linked community groups, and confraternities (kō), but all are characterized by the fact that women play the central roles in the cult.

statement.id: Penganut Oshirasama dapat berupa rumah tangga, kelompok garis keturunan, kelompok komunitas setempat, dan perkumpulan (kō), tetapi semuanya ditandai oleh peran sentral perempuan dalam pemujaan itu.
statement.en: Devotees of Oshirasama may be individual homes, lineage groups, geographically linked community groups and confraternities (kō), but all are characterized by women playing the central roles in the cult.

claims.quote: Called meinichi, the festival day to Oshirasama falls on the sixteenth day of the first, third and ninth months according to the lunar calender.

statement.id: Hari raya Oshirasama, yang disebut meinichi, jatuh pada hari keenam belas bulan pertama, ketiga, dan kesembilan menurut kalender lunar.
statement.en: The festival day of Oshirasama, called meinichi, falls on the sixteenth day of the first, third and ninth months of the lunar calendar.

claims.quote: The itako faces the Oshirasama enshrined on an altar, and reads a mantra meant to invoke the presence of the kami. Next, the itako holds one Oshirasama in each hand and while intoning the Oshira mantra, moves the dolls as though they were dancing, a rite called oshira asobase.

statement.id: Itako menghadap Oshirasama di altar dan membaca mantra untuk memanggil kehadiran kami, lalu memegang satu Oshirasama di tiap tangan dan menggerakkannya seperti menari sambil melafalkan mantra, ritus bernama oshira asobase.
statement.en: The itako faces the Oshirasama on an altar and reads a mantra to invoke the kami's presence, then holds one Oshirasama in each hand and moves the dolls as if dancing while intoning the mantra, a rite called oshira asobase.

claims.quote: Finally, the itako performs divinations for the village or individual households.

statement.id: Pada akhirnya itako melakukan ramalan untuk desa atau rumah tangga perorangan.
statement.en: Finally, the itako performs divinations for the village or individual households.

claims.quote: The Oshirasama cult involves taboos, as it is said that Oshirasama disdains eggs and chickens, as well as the meat of two- and four-legged animals. Breaking one of the taboos may result in a twisted mouth or major illness.

statement.id: Pemujaan Oshirasama mengandung pantangan: dikatakan Oshirasama tidak menyukai telur dan ayam serta daging hewan berkaki dua dan empat. Melanggar pantangan dapat berakibat mulut mencong atau sakit berat.
statement.en: The Oshirasama cult involves taboos: Oshirasama is said to disdain eggs and chickens and the meat of two- and four-legged animals, and breaking a taboo may result in a twisted mouth or major illness.

claims.quote: In addition, should one fail to worship Oshirasama properly, the Oshirasama may visit the family with a curse, or fly away and mysteriously disappear.

statement.id: Bila seseorang tidak memuja Oshirasama dengan semestinya, Oshirasama dapat menimpakan kutukan pada keluarga itu, atau terbang pergi dan menghilang secara misterius.
statement.en: If one fails to worship Oshirasama properly, Oshirasama may visit the family with a curse, or fly away and mysteriously disappear.

short_description.id: Otomitl adalah putra bungsu (xocóyotl, "putra terakhir") dari enam raksasa putra Iztac-Mixcoatl dan Tlaltecuhtli dalam mitologi Aztek [otomitl-c01, otomitl-c02, otomitl-c06].
short_description.en: Otomitl is the youngest (xocóyotl, "the last son") of the six giant sons of Iztac-Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli in Aztec mythology [otomitl-c01, otomitl-c02, otomitl-c06].

long_description.id: Otomitl adalah salah satu dari enam raksasa putra Iztac-Mixcoatl dan Tlaltecuhtli yang menghuni Bumi setelah Air Bah [otomitl-c01]. Sebagai putra keenam, ia mendaki pegunungan dekat Mexico dan membangun Xilotepec, Tollan, dan Otompan [otomitl-c02].
long_description.en: Otomitl is one of the six giant sons of Iztac-Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli who populated the Earth after the Great Flood [otomitl-c01]. The sixth son, he climbed the mountains near Mexico and raised Xilotepec, Tollan and Otompan [otomitl-c02].

long_description.id: Dalam puisi kosmogoni Nahoa beserta catatan kakinya, Otómitl disebut sebagai sang Xocóyotl yang selalu tinggal di pegunungan sekitar Mexico dan makmur di permukiman seperti Túllan, Xilatepéc, dan Otómpan [otomitl-c07]. Catatan kaki menjelaskan bahwa xocóyotl berarti "putra terakhir" [otomitl-c06], dan bahwa permukiman itu kini bernama Tula, Jilotepec, dan Otumba di negara bagian Hidalgo [otomitl-c08].
long_description.en: In the Nahoa cosmogony poem with its footnotes, Otómitl is called the Xocóyotl, who lives always in the mountains around Mexico and prospers in populations such as Túllan, Xilatepéc and Otómpan [otomitl-c07]. Footnotes explain that xocóyotl means "the last son" [otomitl-c06], and that those settlements now carry the names Tula, Jilotepec and Otumba in the state of Hidalgo [otomitl-c08].

long_description.id: Menurut puisi itu, Otómitl adalah salah satu dari enam bersaudara yang lahir dari persatuan "ular ganas dari awan putih" dan menjadi sumber banyak bangsa [otomitl-c03]. Catatan kaki buku itu menyebut kepercayaan orang Indian bahwa bumi mula-mula dihuni raksasa yang disebut quinametzin [otomitl-c04].
long_description.en: According to the poem, Otómitl is one of six brothers born of the union of the "ferocious serpent of white cloud" and the source of many races [otomitl-c03]. A footnote in the book records the Indian belief that the earth was first inhabited by giants called quinametzin [otomitl-c04].

claims.quote: Otomitl (From Nahuatl, 'Jute bone' or 'Where the otomies are') is one of the six giants sons of Iztac-Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli that populated the Earth after the Great Flood during the Fifth Sun in Aztec mythology.

statement.id: Otomitl adalah salah satu dari enam raksasa putra Iztac-Mixcoatl dan Tlaltecuhtli yang menghuni Bumi setelah Air Bah pada masa Matahari Kelima dalam mitologi Aztek.
statement.en: Otomitl is one of the six giant sons of Iztac-Mixcoatl and Tlaltecuhtli who populated the Earth after the Great Flood in the Fifth Sun of Aztec mythology.

claims.quote: The sixth son who climbed the mountains near Mexico, and raised the populations of Xilotepec, Tollan, and Otompan.

statement.id: Ia putra keenam yang mendaki pegunungan dekat Mexico dan membangun permukiman Xilotepec, Tollan, dan Otompan.
statement.en: He was the sixth son, who climbed the mountains near Mexico and raised the settlements of Xilotepec, Tollan and Otompan.

claims.quote: the «ferocious serpent Of white cloud» which lives in Citlálco, (24) With her is joined in sweet union, Of love, which six tlacámes engender; (25) These brothers dwell on the earth And become the source of many races:
claims.locator: Poem, section IV, with footnotes 24 and 25

statement.id: Dalam puisi kosmogoni Nahoa ini, "ular ganas dari awan putih" yang tinggal di Citlálco bersatu dengannya, enam tlacáme (laki-laki) lahir, dan saudara-saudara itu tinggal di bumi serta menjadi sumber banyak bangsa.
statement.en: In this Nahoa cosmogony poem, the "ferocious serpent of white cloud" who lives in Citlálco is joined with her, six tlacámes (men) are engendered, and these brothers dwell on the earth and become the source of many races.

claims.quote: The Indians believed that the earth was first inhabited by giants, and the large pachyderm bones that were found in a fossilized state in excavations, were their remains. They called them quinametzin,

statement.id: Catatan kaki dalam buku yang sama menyebut bahwa orang Indian percaya bumi mula-mula dihuni raksasa, dan tulang besar yang ditemukan dalam keadaan fosil di galian dianggap sisa-sisa mereka; mereka menyebutnya quinametzin.
statement.en: A footnote in the same book says the Indians believed the earth was first inhabited by giants, and that the large fossilized bones found in excavations were their remains; they called them quinametzin.

claims.quote: The firstborn, the giant Xélhua, ... Tenoch, the great ... The strong Cuetlaxcoápan founded Ulmécatl; ... Xicaláncatl; ... The valiant Mixtécatl guards himself ... Otómitl, the Xocóyotl, lives ever

statement.id: Puisi itu menyebut keenam bersaudara berurutan: Xélhua si sulung (raksasa), Tenoch, Ulmécatl, Xicaláncatl, Mixtécatl, dan Otómitl, "Xocóyotl".
statement.en: The poem names the six brothers in turn: Xélhua the firstborn (a giant), Tenoch, Ulmécatl, Xicaláncatl, Mixtécatl, and Otómitl, "the Xocóyotl".

claims.quote: Xocóyotl means “the last son.“ From this word was formed the Aztec expression

statement.id: Catatan kaki buku itu menyatakan bahwa Xocóyotl berarti "putra terakhir", dan dari kata itu terbentuk ungkapan Aztek "socoyote".
statement.en: Robelo's footnote says Xocóyotl means "the last son", and that the Aztec expression "socoyote" was formed from this word.

claims.quote: Otómitl, the Xocóyotl, lives ever ... In the mountains that lie around Mexico And there prospers in rich populations, Such as Túllan, of wisdom the emporium, Xilatepéc and Otómpan, of labor.

statement.id: Dalam puisi itu, Otómitl, sang Xocóyotl, selalu tinggal di pegunungan di sekitar Mexico dan makmur di permukiman padat seperti Túllan, Xilatepéc, dan Otómpan.
statement.en: In Robelo's poem, Otómitl, the Xocóyotl, lives always in the mountains around Mexico and prospers in rich populations such as Túllan, Xilatepéc and Otómpan.

claims.quote: These populations now carry the names of Tula, Jilotepec, Otumba and all belong to the state of Hidalgo.

statement.id: Catatan kaki buku itu menyatakan bahwa permukiman-permukiman itu kini bernama Tula, Jilotepec, dan Otumba, dan semuanya termasuk negara bagian Hidalgo.
statement.en: Robelo's footnote states that these populations now carry the names Tula, Jilotepec and Otumba, and all belong to the state of Hidalgo.

Robelo, The Four Suns (1907, archive.org) ditambahkan. Mendieta, Torquemada dan Orozco y Berra tidak ditemukan dalam teks yang bisa dicari; blog dan situs "dewa dan monster" tanpa penulis tidak dipakai. Robelo menulis puisi modern berdasar sumber lama, sehingga klaimnya diberi konteks tafsiran ilmiah.

short_description.id: Pallas adalah salah satu Gigantes, raksasa keturunan Gaia, yang menurut kisah dikuliti Athena dalam perang melawan para dewa.
short_description.en: Pallas is one of the Gigantes, giants born of Gaia, who in the tale was flayed by Athena in the war against the gods.

long_description.id: Pallas adalah salah satu Gigantes, keturunan Gaia yang lahir dari darah Uranus yang dikebiri. Ia disebut Gigante yang tewas oleh Athena dalam perang melawan para dewa.
long_description.en: Pallas was one of the Gigantes, born to Gaia from the blood shed when Uranus was castrated. He is described as a Gigante killed by Athena in the war against the gods.

long_description.id: Dalam Gigantomachy, Athena mengulitinya dan memakai kulitnya sebagai perisai. Sumber lain menambahkan bahwa kulit itu dipakai Athena untuk melindungi tubuhnya selama pertempuran, dan menyebutnya kulit mirip kambing yang dijadikan perisai aigis.
long_description.en: In the Gigantomachy, Athena flayed him and used his skin as a shield. Another source adds that Athena used the skin to protect her own body during the battle, and describes it as a goatish skin made into the aigis shield.

long_description.id: Identitasnya diperselisihkan: menurut sebagian, Pallas bukan Gigante melainkan Titan lawan Athena dalam Titanomachy, dan ia mungkin sama dengan Titan bernama sama.
long_description.en: His identity is disputed: some hold that Pallas was a Titan who fought Athena in the earlier Titanomachy rather than a Gigante, and he was perhaps the same figure as the Titan with the same name.

short_description.id: Pincoy adalah roh laut laki-laki dalam mitologi Chilote, putra Millalobo, yang lagunya memulai tarian kesuburan Pincoya [pincoy-c01, pincoy-c03, pincoy-c05].
short_description.en: The Pincoy is a male sea spirit of Chilote mythology, son of Millalobo, whose song starts the Pincoya's fertility dance [pincoy-c01, pincoy-c03, pincoy-c05].

long_description.id: Pincoy adalah roh air laut laki-laki dalam mitologi Chilote [pincoy-c01]. Ia mirip manusia duyung bertubuh singa laut berwarna emas dan berwajah tampan [pincoy-c02]. Ia putra Millalobo dan Huenchula; saudarinya adalah Sirena chilota dan Pincoya, yang juga istrinya [pincoy-c03].
long_description.en: The Pincoy is a male sea spirit of Chilote mythology [pincoy-c01]. He resembles a merman with a golden sea-lion body and a handsome face [pincoy-c02]. He is the son of Millalobo and Huenchula; his sisters are the Sirena chilota and the Pincoya, also his wife [pincoy-c03].

long_description.id: Dalam uraian Chiloé Mitológico, Pincoy bertubuh anjing laut besar berwarna perak mengilap dengan wajah manusia yang tampan dan surai emas [pincoy-c06]. Ia mengelola wilayah kekuasaan ayahnya dan mengawasi proses di laut [pincoy-c07], serta selalu memperhatikan kegiatan saudari-saudarinya, Pincoya dan Sirena [pincoy-c08].
long_description.en: In the Chiloé Mitológico account, the Pincoy has the body of a large bright-silver seal with a handsome human face and a golden mane [pincoy-c06]. He administers his father's domains and watches over the processes of the sea [pincoy-c07], and keeps watch over the activities of his sisters, the Pincoya and the Sirena [pincoy-c08].

long_description.id: Kisah menyebut Pincoy dan Pincoya sekaligus bersaudara dan suami istri [pincoy-c09]; penulis menafsirkan hal ini mungkin sebagai penggandaan legenda perkawinan Millalobo dengan Huenchula [pincoy-c10]. Di pulau Alao, seorang anak berkepala anjing laut yang lahir dari seorang gadis dikaitkan dengan Pincoy [pincoy-c12], dan nelayan pulau Llingua mengaku melihatnya berenang sangat cepat [pincoy-c13].
long_description.en: The tale presents the Pincoy and the Pincoya as both siblings and spouses [pincoy-c09]; the author suggests this may be a duplication of the legend of Millalobo's marriage to Huenchula [pincoy-c10]. On the island of Alao, a seal-headed child born to a girl was blamed on the Pincoy [pincoy-c12], and fishermen of Llingua say they saw him swimming at great speed [pincoy-c13].

statement.en: The author suggests this may be explained as a duplication of the same legend, that of the marriage of Millalobo with Huenchula.

claims.quote: Todas las versiones coinciden en decir que es muy hermoso, atrayente y que le agrada la música, sintiendo atracción muy especial, por la que produce la flauta hecha de colihue (a esta afición debe seguramente su nombre: de Pinculhue=flauta).

statement.id: Semua versi sepakat bahwa ia sangat tampan dan memikat serta menyukai musik, terutama suara seruling dari colihue; penulis menduga namanya berasal dari kegemaran ini (Pinculhue = seruling).
statement.en: All versions agree that he is very handsome and attractive and likes music, especially the sound of a flute made of colihue; the author presumes his name comes from this fondness (Pinculhue = flute).

claims.quote: En la isla de Alao, se cuenta, que en la casa donde vivía una muchacha admirada como hermosa, nació un niño con cabeza de foca, que sólo vivió escasas horas y cuya paternidad se culpó al Pincoy;

statement.id: Diceritakan bahwa di pulau Alao, di rumah seorang gadis yang dikagumi karena kecantikannya, lahir seorang anak berkepala anjing laut yang hidup hanya beberapa jam, dan ayahnya dituduhkan kepada Pincoy.
statement.en: It is told that on the island of Alao, in the house of a girl admired for her beauty, a child with a seal's head was born who lived only a few hours, and paternity was blamed on the Pincoy.

claims.quote: Pescadores de la isla Llingua, famosos por sus proezas marineras, cuentan haber visto al Pincoy, durante sus faenas de pesca, nadando a velocidad extraordinaria, brillando como un rayo plateado

statement.id: Nelayan pulau Llingua, yang terkenal karena kecakapan melautnya, mengaku pernah melihat Pincoy berenang dengan kecepatan luar biasa, berkilau seperti sinar perak, saat mereka menangkap ikan.
statement.en: Fishermen of the island of Llingua, famous for their seamanship, say they have seen the Pincoy while fishing, swimming at extraordinary speed and shining like a silver ray.

summary.id: Artikel ensiklopedia daring: tubuh singa laut besar berwarna emas cerah.
summary.en: Online encyclopedia article: a large sea-lion body in bright golden colour.

summary.id: Chiloé Mitológico: tubuh anjing laut (foca) besar berwarna perak mengilap, dengan surai emas.
summary.en: Chiloé Mitológico: the body of a large seal (foca) in bright silver, with a golden mane.

selection_criteria: computeFillStatus must be lengkap-informasi: complete, valid research without an approved image.
No active editorial artwork and no permanent artwork exclusion.
The accepted research entry is embedded unchanged; the image may only depict what its claims document.
Creatures an earlier batch left out keep that reason as catatan_sebelumnya; the generator may decline them with status tidak-digambar.

user_policy.name: sangar
user_policy.intent: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
user_policy.subject: The being dominates the frame and is clearly the subject. Head, eyes and distinguishing traits are readable even at thumbnail size. Never a landscape without the being, never a human who could be a passer-by, never a farm animal at pasture.
user_policy.moment: Depict a moment, not a pose: hunting, emerging, striking, commanding, towering, descending, tearing through weather or ground. Gaze and posture confront or loom over the viewer. Standing still and facing the camera with a neutral expression is not acceptable.
user_policy.effects: Visible power is wanted and may be strong, but every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute, habitat or deed documented in the research claims of that being, and it must act physically on the world: ground cracking, water rearing, trees bending, lightning striking, flame consuming, fog pouring, bodies of victims turned to stone. No generic glowing envelope, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes or luminous coloured mist. If the research documents no power, build menace from anatomy, scale, moment, light and setting instead, and record that in artistic_choices.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, eyes, limbs and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects and atmosphere add power; they never replace or invent anatomy. Fully opaque clothing where a humanlike form is clothed; no nudity, no explicit gore.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle; monumental or predatory scale with small environmental references when size is documented, otherwise dominance through tight framing and foreshortening. Strong silhouette, high contrast, cinematic low-key lighting from one dominant source (moon, fire, lightning, dying sun), rim light, dust, smoke, rain or spray. Tactile surfaces: wet scales, matted fur, cracked skin, rust, weathered cloth, stone.
user_policy.setting: The place its stories name: graveyard, swamp, sea cliff, battlefield, celestial palace, desert storm. Weather and time of day heighten threat or majesty. Palette is dark and warm with one strong accent, consistent with the collection; no pastel, no flat even daylight.
user_policy.respect: Living religions (Hindu, Buddhist, Shinto, Abrahamic and folk deities still worshipped) are majestic and overwhelming rather than monstrous: cosmic scale, divine radiance from documented attributes, the elements they rule in motion. Malevolent beings are menacing. Literary beings follow their source text, never a film, game, anime or comic design.
user_policy.aniconic: If the research documents no bodily form at all, either depict the documented manifestation as an active, overwhelming force (the sky itself splitting, a storm swallowing the steppe) with the choice recorded in artistic_choices, or decline the entry with status tidak-digambar. A calm scene without agency fails.
user_policy.self_check: Before accepting an image the generator answers all of these with yes: the being dominates the frame; it still looks dangerous or majestic at 200 px; there is a moment, not a static pose; each visible effect points to a claim id; head, eye and limb counts match the claims; no text, watermark, border or borrowed design; it would not be rejected as ordinary person, ordinary animal, landscape only, or cute and calm. One no means regenerate, keep the rejected attempt as history, up to three attempts.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly cinematic illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Every design is original and sourced from the accepted research.
